Messages.Author: Michael Deflize
Messages.Body:
The following situation arose during play here in germany:

Situation:

Meth A calls a Disputed Territory on Meth B's Location. Meth B has 1
pool. Referendum starts, Meth B's Primogen votes against the
Referendum. Meth A plays Scorn of Adonis. Now before results are
tallied, Meth B loses 1 pool and is ousted.

Questions:

1. Does Meth A get the location? We think no, since Meth B is ousted
during the referendum and so it's no longer around at the point where
the action resolves.

2. Does the referendum just end when B is ousted, since it no longer
has a valid target, or does it continue as normal (interesting for
Voter Caps) and he just does not get the location? I would say it just
continues as normal (since it has to reach the before results are
tallied stage anyway) and just has no effect since it's target is
gone, but we are not sure about this.

3. What happenes with the Vote of the vampire that vanishes when B is
ousted? (a google search indicated thst a vote that was cast stays
around even if the vampire leaves play during the referendum).

thanks for your help
Michael

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Michael Deflize wrote:
> Meth A calls a Disputed Territory on Meth B's Location. Meth B has 1
> pool. Referendum starts, Meth B's Primogen votes against the
> Referendum. Meth A plays Scorn of Adonis. Now before results are
> tallied, Meth B loses 1 pool and is ousted.
>
> Questions:
>
> 1. Does Meth A get the location? We think no, since Meth B is ousted
> during the referendum and so it's no longer around at the point where
> the action resolves.

Correct.

> 2. Does the referendum just end when B is ousted, since it no longer
> has a valid target, or does it continue as normal (interesting for
> Voter Caps) and he just does not get the location? I would say it just
> continues as normal (since it has to reach the before results are
> tallied stage anyway) and just has no effect since it's target is
> gone, but we are not sure about this.

Correct.

> 3. What happenes with the Vote of the vampire that vanishes when B is
> ousted? (a google search indicated thst a vote that was cast stays
> around even if the vampire leaves play during the referendum).

Scorn won't oust the player until the results are tallied, so the vote
counts (if it didn't, the player wouldn't be ousted).
